The entire memory-plus-program generator is conjugated, not only the command drive. DATA decoding is unchanged, while the whole target-frame readout may be target-dependent and cross-block. It does not supply noisy retrieval, reusable arbitrary gate sequences, selected logical-pair addressability, universal/non-Clifford computation, passive protection or practical constants. Ideal target forest removal plus the ordinary product DATA decoder remain paid output interfaces; no favorable threshold or device benchmark is supplied

Standard scheduled transversal CNOT/recovery retains its full input, control, noise and output model. The separate noisy-classical comparator covers fixed-iteration scheduled MEMORY rounds, not every gate/final-decoder extension
